newsitem.title: UK: Booker falls on restructuring, sales news.
newsitem.headline: Booker falls on restructuring, sales news.

text.p: Shares in food distributor Booker Plc slumped in early Friday trade after the company announced a one-off restructuring charge of 25 million stg and said group sales were up three percent over the year.
The shares were 13-1/2p lower at 385-1/2p by 0839 GMT.
In a trading statement the company said it would take the restructuring charge against its 1996 results as it rationalises its network of Foodservice sites.
The company said group sales for the year rose three percent on a like-for-like basis whilst sales over the Christmas period were slightly ahead of last year.

Meanwhile, sales at the recently acquired Nurdin & Peacock Plc business were six percent lower than in the same period last year, Booker said. But profit contribution since the acquisition was slightly ahead of expectations.
